verdict: Lead volume is down sharply; Google spend produced zero leads this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 33 leads at a cost of $115.19 per lead — all 33 came from Meta, while $2,113.86 in Google Ads spend produced zero conversions. In the most recent 7 days, leads dropped 46% while spend held flat, which drove cost per lead up 86% week-over-week and points to a tracking or form issue on the paid search side rather than a budget problem. Separately, 91 leads have entered your CRM this period but none have progressed to appointments or closed cases, which suggests an intake routing issue that is being investigated now. Google Ads conversion tracking is being repaired so that spend is no longer running without measurable results. Once tracking is confirmed, campaign performance will reflect accurately and optimization can begin in earnest.
